newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary urges expansion of off-floor state debt trading.
- The State Asset Management Bureau revokes business licenses of two asset evaluation organisations for irregularities.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by a year-on-year 13.7 percent in the first half of this year and the city's target for the full year is 10 percent.
- Finance officials and experts met in Shanghai to discuss standardisation of the securities markets.
